context: Request: how many Healthcare & Life Sciences matters involved informed consent or an IRB, listed (for a life-sciences pitch). Rubric: 1018-00004 (Penterra), 1029-00001 (Thornwick), 1037-00002 (Solstice) and a precision criterion; extra matters such as 1013-00004, 1018-00003, 1018-00005, 1018-00008 fail it.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob plus directory and file counts.

stages.stage: List matter folders
stages.note: declared: List files in the document store (attempt 2). Lists the top-level folder, counts 266 matter folders and prints the first 20 names. The end review's label note also names folder listing, and the next stage is declared that way.

stages.stage: List matter folders
stages.note: Per-matter file counts and extension tally, with the file lists of three sample matters.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide extraction script for practice-group and consent terms saves hits to a file: 17 practice-hit matters, 22 consent-hit matters, 8 both. The review flags the intersection as dropping matters.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: declared: new: Resolve practice group for all <topic>-hit matters. Scripts over the saved hit file and the engagement documents of the 31-matter union (one heredoc error, one empty grep of the saved file), then pages through the saved results.
stages.agent_new: Resolve practice group for all clinical-hit matters

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: declared: new: Per-matter <practice> and <topic> verification. A verification script over the 31 candidates, then reads of 21 engagement letters, memos and agreements across about ten candidates, plus an exact-term table script (one heredoc error). The summary counts five matters; the review flags that two of them show no consent or review-board passage in the reads.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: declared: new: Per-matter <practice> and <topic> verification (attempt 2). Reads four further documents of the two borderline matters at offsets; both kept. The review (goal not reached) again says their support is only asserted.

stages.stage: Tabulate candidate matters from saved results
stages.note: declared: new: Complete per-matter verification table. Writes an audit table of the 31 candidates with five inclusions to a working file (not the deliverable).

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: declared: Check or revise the response. No response exists yet; re-reads the audit file and the opening of four included matters' documents. The end review's label note names listing-picked reads; the next stage is a text check, not reads.

stages.stage: Search within a candidate matter's files
stages.note: Extracts consent and review-board passages from four documents of the two borderline matters and a related folder. The end review's label note names the text scan; writing follows.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes five qualifying matters with documents, a numbering caveat and exclusions.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Attempt 2: path-check script fails on the response location, then re-reads the response and checks 21 cited paths.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.failure_point: Counted two practice-group matters whose documents only mention review-board approval in passing as qualifying, alongside the three with direct consent and review-board work.

first_error.critic_note: (specific flag) The review at [75] said the two borderline matters' reads show no consent or review-board content and to include them only on a literal passage; the review at [84] repeated it. The agent re-read and extracted passages from both and kept them.
first_error.why: The answer counts two matters as qualifying on a pediatric-study deferral memo and a coverage-evidence memo that only mention review-board approval in passing (evidence seen at [47]-[84], [103]).

runs.failure_point: Grew the qualifying set from three to sixteen after a review called the three-matter set hand-picked, counting matters on single snippet-led reads.

first_error.critic_note: (specific flag) The scan review at [98] called the three-matter set hand-picked and its exclusions unbacked and asked for snippets across all hit matters; the agent widened and the set grew to 16 on one-document reads.
first_error.why: The answer counts 16 matters as qualifying, adding 13 whose documents use consent or review-board terms in diligence, disclosure or privacy contexts (evidence seen at [99]-[117]), after the agent's scan stage had kept only three.

divergence: All three runs fail the precision criterion the same way, at the write stage: each names all three needed matters but adds others (two in T0, three in T1, thirteen in T2) whose documents only mention consent or review-board terms in passing. Reviews in T0 and T1 named the extra matters specifically; the agents re-read or extracted passages and kept them. In T2 the scan stage had the exact three-matter set, and the review called it hand-picked; the agent widened and wrote sixteen. Agent-defined stages (T0, T1) carried the per-matter verification work but did not change the outcome; label notes were ignored or did not apply.
